US Probes Universities Over J-1 Visas Amid Student Rule Tightening

The U.S. is investigating nine universities concerning the J-1 exchange visitor visa program, as the Trump administration tightens student-related rules. Senator JD Vance alleged that universities were utilizing foreign researchers to lower wages for American graduate students and researchers.
